article.title: -(으)면 안 돼요
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
article.chapter: Deseo, obligación, permiso y capacidad — 희망·의무·허가·능력

claims.summary: The NIKL guide treats **-(으)면 안 되다** as a prohibition expression; it gives the politeness-level form **안 돼요** in classroom permission/prohibition contexts and contrasts a prohibited action with the permission construction **-어도 되다**. This entry is limited to that use.
